purpose: known-positive and known-negative for the cross-request state-reuse class (state-integrity S2)
runtime: node cluster; honours WORKERS and CLUSTER_SCHED_POLICY from instrument.py's pool shape

seeds.how: identity A requests /whoami with Authorization: Bearer alice, then an UNAUTHENTICATED request to /whoami on the same worker returns identity 'alice'
seeds.why: module scope has worker lifetime and is never cleared at request end - the CVE-2026-109619 shape in a managed language

seeds.how: identity A writes ?note=..., then an unauthenticated request to /note returns null
seeds.why: same shape, keyed per identity and read only with that identity's own key. A run that reports this is producing false positives - a correctly isolated cache is not a finding

worker_identification.note: a probe must state WHICH worker served each request; same-worker is a precondition, not an assumption

distribution_trap.default_policy: 12 sequential requests reached 1 of 4 workers - total affinity
distribution_trap.sched_rr: 12 sequential requests reached 4 of 4 workers - perfect round-robin
distribution_trap.consequence: raising WORKERS is NOT a negative control. The control must set CLUSTER_SCHED_POLICY=rr.
